Proposition

↗ cor:8-31

1. ch8:8.33The Lie bracket of two smooth left-invariant vector fields on a Lie group is left-invariant.

Proof

\sketch For every $g\in G$, Corollary 6 gives

\[ (L_g)_*[X,Y]=[(L_g)_*X,(L_g)_*Y]=[X,Y]. \]

□
